cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(purifier_ffi VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C)
find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)
add_library(proof SHARED proof.c)
target_link_libraries(proof PRIVATE ZLIB::ZLIB)
target_include_directories(proof PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
install(TARGETS proof LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES proof.h DESTINATION include)
configure_file(proof.pc.in proof.pc @ONLY)
install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/proof.pc DESTINATION lib/pkgconfig)
